resolution.note: krn worker live session with path tiers; D13 amendment; measurement in t-qkqkwt6

title: Keep one live worker session per slice instead of exec plus resume
body:
Outcome: a slice keeps one live worker session (krn worker start|send|stop over codex app-server) that loads the repository once and receives fix rounds as further turns with explicit model and effort; scope is path tiers from spec/worker-scope.json checked on the diff after every turn, not an exhaustive --allow list; per-turn usage and minutes are written to the run dir in the canary unit. ADR 0014 records the D13 amendment and its budget. The measurement against PR #167 and the switch of lead delegation moved to t-qkqkwt6.
Source: operator 2026-11-02: delegating through a command is slowing delivery and the architecture needs improvement.
